## Research integrity

- [ ] Sources, reading extent, uncertainty and verification roles are truthful.
- [ ] Findings, interpretations, hypotheses and project constraints remain distinct.
- [ ] Synthetic fixtures, restricted sources and private data cannot contaminate public evidence.
- [ ] Counts, references and affected downstream claims are reconciled.
- [ ] AI assistance and actual human/external-review status are disclosed.
- [ ] Issue acceptance is satisfied, or unmet items/gates remain open with a checkpoint.

## Review, merge and post-merge

Material findings resolved; required checks and approvals satisfied on final head. Record merge SHA and main push-check result after landing; do not claim a pending check passed.
